command:
set -euo pipefail
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -eu
pid=$(pgrep -f '[p]ython.*server.py' | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -z "$pid" ]; then echo 'PhotoMap server process not found'; exit 2; fi
cwd=$(readlink -f "/proc/$pid/cwd")
exe=$(readlink -f "/proc/$pid/exe")
PID="$pid" CWD="$cwd" "$exe" - <<'PY'
import os
import sqlite3
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

pid=os.environ['PID']; cwd=Path(os.environ['CWD'])
proc_env={}
for item in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0'):
    if b'=' in item:
        k,v=item.split(b'=',1); proc_env[k.decode(errors='replace')]=v.decode(errors='replace')
backend=cwd/'backend'
data=Path(proc_env.get('PHOTOMAP_DATA_DIR',str(backend/'data'))).expanduser()
db_url=proc_env.get('DATABASE_URL',f'sqlite:///{data/"app.db"}')
if not db_url.startswith('sqlite:///'): raise SystemExit('Expected sqlite database')
db=Path(db_url.removeprefix('sqlite:///'))
if not db.is_absolute(): db=(cwd/db).resolve()
conn=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro',uri=True); conn.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
try:
    rows=conn.execute('SELECT id, place_id, status, original_path, public_path, approved_at, created_at FROM photo ORDER BY created_at').fetchall()
finally:
    conn.close()

def kind(path):
    name=Path(path).name
    if '-retained' in name: return 'retained'
    if '-original' in name: return 'original'
    return 'other'

all_counts=Counter(kind(r['original_path']) for r in rows)
status_counts=Counter((r['status'],kind(r['original_path'])) for r in rows)
print('=== ORIGINAL PATH CLASSIFICATION ===')
print('total_rows='+str(len(rows)))
for k in sorted(all_counts): print(f'{k}={all_counts[k]}')
print('=== BY STATUS ===')
for (status,k),n in sorted(status_counts.items()): print(f'{status}.{k}={n}')
retained=[r for r in rows if kind(r['original_path'])=='retained']
print(f'retained_rows={len(retained)}')
if retained:
    print('retained_samples:')
    for r in retained[:20]: print(f'  id={r["id"]} status={r["status"]} approved_at={r["approved_at"]} original_path={r["original_path"]}')
print('created_at_min='+str(rows[0]['created_at'] if rows else None))
print('created_at_max='+str(rows[-1]['created_at'] if rows else None))
approved_dates=[r['approved_at'] for r in rows if r['approved_at']]
print('approved_at_min='+str(min(approved_dates) if approved_dates else None))
print('approved_at_max='+str(max(approved_dates) if approved_dates else None))
PY
REMOTE
